major_cooldowns.name: Avenging Wrath
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it before your other cooldowns so Execution Sentence, Wake of Ashes, and your on-use trinkets all land inside its window.

major_cooldowns.name: Execution Sentence
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it once Avenging Wrath is active, then keep hitting every target it caught with your other damage since that funnels into its payout.

major_cooldowns.name: Wake of Ashes
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it on cooldown as your main Holy Power generator, timing it inside Execution Sentence's window when both are up together.

major_cooldowns.name: Divine Toll
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it after your other cooldowns are already rolling; it does not need to be synced to Avenging Wrath.

rule.description: Open Blade of Justice into your cooldowns
rule.action: Open with Blade of Justice, then Avenging Wrath with your on-use trinkets, then Execution Sentence, Wake of Ashes, and Divine Toll.

rule.description: Execution Sentence lines up with Avenging Wrath
rule.action: Wait for Avenging Wrath to be active before casting Execution Sentence so its full window gets the damage buff.

rule.description: Spend Art of War procs with Blade of Justice
rule.action: Cast Blade of Justice as soon as Art of War procs; you have two stacks of leeway but do not let a stack expire unused.

rule.description: Final Verdict spent at full Holy Power
rule.action: Hold Final Verdict for a full bar of Holy Power instead of spending it early.

rule.description: Divine Storm takes over on multiple targets
rule.action: Switch your Holy Power spender to Divine Storm once enough enemies are up instead of single-target finishers.
